Maintainer.Profile: Nightlight is a self-hosted baby monitor: low-latency multi-camera streaming from RTSP cameras, sleep and motion/sound detection, and an installable PWA - no cloud, no subscription, no account anywhere but your own network. This repository publishes the Community Applications template for it.
Maintainer.DonateText: Nightlight is free and open source. If it helps you keep watch over your little ones, consider supporting its development.
